description:
This three-bedroom detached bungalow presents an excellent opportunity for those seeking a renovation project in a highly convenient location close to Mullingar town centre. Set on a private site with a large rear garden, detached garage and ample parking, the property offers endless potential for buyers looking to modernise and create a family home to their own specification.

The accommodation comprises an entrance hall with timber flooring leading to a spacious open-plan living, dining and kitchen area featuring timber flooring, a bay window, solid fuel stove and tiled kitchen area with side access. There are three bedrooms, two of which are double rooms, all benefiting from timber or laminate flooring, while the main bedroom enjoys fitted wardrobes and a bay window. A family bathroom completes the accommodation and features a bath, WC, wash hand basin and wall and floor tiling.

Externally, the property benefits from a large private rear garden with patio area, decking and a detached garage/shed offering excellent storage or workshop potential. The driveway provides ample off-street parking.

Ideally located on the Ballynacarrigy Road, the property is within walking distance of Mullingar town centre, local schools and the Midland Regional Hospital. The nearby link road provides easy access to the N4 and excellent connectivity to Dublin and surrounding towns.

Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the potential this property has to offer.
